title: Dental PPO Plans Benefit Accumulators
content:
**Rule.** Accumulators of the Dental PPO Plans (the annual maximum used, the deductible satisfied, the rollover balance and the pediatric out-of-pocket amount) are moved only by claim decisions, on the decision date, for the benefit year of the line.

| Decision | Posting |
|---|---|
| Paid or reprocessed line | Its plan payment is posted to the annual maximum, except the part paid from rollover dollars, preventive lines on plans whose annual maximum does not apply to preventive services, and lines of a person receiving the pediatric essential-health-benefit treatment; a line paying 0.00 posts nothing |
| Line that applied deductible | That deductible is posted to the deductible |
| In-network line of a person receiving the pediatric essential-health-benefit treatment | Its member responsibility is posted to the pediatric out-of-pocket accumulator |
| Reprocessed line | Every posting the original line made is reversed for the same amount and benefit year before the corrected line posts its own amounts |
| Denied or pended line | No accumulator moves |
| Estimate | No accumulator ever moves |

### Example (hypothetical)
A line posted 140.00 to the annual maximum and 30.00 to the deductible in a benefit year. When it is reprocessed, a 140.00 maximum reversal and a 30.00 deductible reversal are booked for that same benefit year, and the corrected line then posts its own amounts.
